# Douyin Downloader

[简体中文](https://github.com/jiji262/douyin-downloader/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) · **English** **A Douyin skill for AI agents.** Let Claude Code, Codex, and other agents read the hot board, search, look up profiles, record live streams, and transcribe media. Every `douyin-dl agent` command prints one JSON line with stable error codes, and the bundled [skill](#ai-agent--skill) tells the agent when and how to call it. To download videos and photos without watermarks, use the **[Douzy desktop app](#douzy-desktop)**. ## AI Agent / Skill **1. Install the CLI** ```bash uv tool install douyin-dl-cli # or: pipx install douyin-dl-cli # unreleased code from GitHub: uv tool install git+https://github.com/jiji262/douyin-downloader douyin-dl agent doctor ``` The PyPI package is `douyin-dl-cli`; the command it installs is `douyin-dl`. In a cloned checkout with the requirements installed, `python run.py agent doctor` works too. Do not `pip install` the package into a shared environment: its top-level packages `utils`, `core`, and `config` collide with other projects. **2. Install the skill** (pick one) ```bash # Claude Code /plugin marketplace add jiji262/douyin-downloader /plugin install douyin-dl@douyin-dl # Codex and other agents: copy the folder (run from a clone of this repo) cp -r skills/douyin-dl ~/.agents/skills/ # or use the skills CLI npx skills add jiji262/douyin-downloader ``` **3. Ask your agent** - "What's on Douyin's hot board right now?" - "Search Douyin for `cats` and summarize the top 10 posts." - "Look up this creator's profile: `https://www.douyin.com/user/…`" - "Record this live room for 5 minutes: `https://live.douyin.com/…`" - "Transcribe `./clip.mp4`." The agent runs commands such as `douyin-dl agent hot --max 3` and reads the single JSON line they print: ```bash douyin-dl agent hot --max 3 # {"schema":1,"ok":true,"verb":"hot","version":"2.1.0","data":{"items":[…],"count":3},"error":null,"warnings":[]} ``` | Status | Capabilities | |:---|:---| | Available | Hot search board (`hot`), link classification (`inspect`), live recording (`live`), local transcription (`transcribe`), environment check (`doctor`) | | Sign-in required | Keyword search (`search`), profile info (`user`); sign in with `douyin-dl agent login` in your own browser window | | Blocked | Downloading videos/photos, collections, music, or a profile's posts by link returns `ARGUS_GATED`. Use **Douzy** | - Agent mode keeps its own sign-in in `~/.douyin-dl` (set `DOUYIN_DL_HOME` to move it). It does not read `config.yml` or the cookies saved by `tools.cookie_fetcher`, and cookie values never appear in its output. - `login` needs Playwright and Chromium; `transcribe` needs Whisper. `doctor` lists what is missing with the exact install command. - Set `DOUYIN_PROXY` to send requests through a proxy. Stable error and exit codes, field by field: [contract](https://github.com/jiji262/douyin-downloader/blob/main/skills/douyin-dl/references/contract.md) · [troubleshooting](https://github.com/jiji262/douyin-downloader/blob/main/skills/douyin-dl/references/troubleshooting.md) ## Douzy Desktop Download Douyin videos and photos without watermarks with a desktop app for **Douyin, TikTok, YouTube, Telegram, and X**. Paste links, track downloads, and browse your local archive. **[Download for Windows / macOS](https://github.com/jiji262/douyin-downloader/releases)** Platform features depend on enabled plugins or local components. Some batch and advanced features require activation. | Platform | Content | |:---|:---| | Douyin | Videos, photos, profiles, collections; following, subscriptions, favorites, and likes | | TikTok | Public videos, photos, and profiles | | YouTube | Videos, Shorts, channels, and playlists; audio and subtitles | | Telegram | Media from accessible chats, groups, and channels; requires setup and sign-in | | X | Posts, profile media, your bookmarks and likes; requires account cookies | | **Douyin** | **TikTok** | **YouTube** | |:---:|:---:|:---:| | | | | | **Telegram setup** | **X** | **Task center** | | | | | | **Douyin (light)** | **YouTube (light)** | **Task center (light)** | |:---:|:---:|:---:| | | | | _Screenshots: Douzy 0.13.0 on macOS (light and dark themes, 1440 × 900, sample data). Telegram is shown before setup. Click an image to enlarge._ ## Classic CLI The original batch downloader (`python run.py`) supports **Douyin only**. It includes batch downloads, date filters, retries, download history, and optional comments, transcription, and notifications. > **Download limitations:** Douyin's request verification currently blocks CLI downloads of individual videos/photos, collections, music, likes, and favorites. Profile posts can try the Playwright browser fallback, but success is not guaranteed. Use **Douzy** for everyday downloads. Refreshing cookies or retrying does not fix this verification block. Live recording is experimental: FFmpeg records the stream in segments, converts each segment to MP4, and reconnects after drops. ### Quick Start Requires **Python 3.10+** on Windows, macOS, or Linux. Read the CLI limitations above first. #### 1. Install ```bash git clone https://github.com/jiji262/douyin-downloader.git cd douyin-downloader python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pip install playwright python -m playwright install chromium ``` #### 2. Configure and sign in Copy [config.example.yml](https://github.com/jiji262/douyin-downloader/blob/main/config.example.yml) to `config.yml`: ```bash cp config.example.yml config.yml python -m tools.cookie_fetcher --config config.yml ``` On Windows PowerShell, use `Copy-Item config.example.yml config.yml` to copy the file. Sign in to Douyin in the browser, then return to the terminal and press Enter to save cookies. Replace the sample `link` in `config.yml` with your creator's profile URL. Keep the saved cookies and adjust these fields: ```yaml link: - https://www.douyin.com/user/YOUR_SEC_UID path: ./Downloaded/ mode: [post] number: post: 10 # 0 = unlimited increase: post: true # skip downloaded items redownload_missing_files: true ``` #### 3. Run ```bash python run.py -c config.yml ``` Use `python run.py --help` for all options. | Option | Purpose | |:---|:---| | `-c, --config` | Config file | | `-u, --url` | Append a URL to the links in the config; repeatable | | `-p, --path` | Download folder | | `-t, --thread` | Concurrent downloads | | `-v, --verbose` | Detailed logs | | Exit code | Meaning | |:---|:---| | `0` | Finished. Some items may still have failed; check the summary | | `1` | Nothing was downloaded or skipped and at least one item failed, or a fatal error occurred | | `3` | The sign-in expired and could not be renewed; the other URLs in the batch were still processed | ### Configuration Full settings and examples: **[config.example.yml](https://github.com/jiji262/douyin-downloader/blob/main/config.example.yml)**. | Setting | Purpose | |:---|:---| | `number.post` | Item limit; `0` means unlimited | | `start_time` / `end_time` | Date range (`YYYY-MM-DD`); includes the whole end date | | `video_quality` | `highest` by default; `original` tries the original upload and falls back | | `increase.post` | `true` skips downloaded items; `false` downloads again and overwrites files in the selected scope | | `redownload_missing_files` | Default `true`: download missing files again. With `false`, valid database history can still skip them | Incremental downloads check for non-empty primary media on disk. You do **not** need to clear the database to download again: set `increase.post: false`. The same switch is available for `like`, `mix`, and `music`.
More CLI commands ```bash # Hot search board and keyword search → JSONL python run.py --hot-board 30 python run.py --search "cats" --search-max 50 # Optional REST API server python -m pip install fastapi uvicorn python run.py --serve --serve-port 8000 ``` Comments, transcription, notifications, and live recording are configured in [config.example.yml](https://github.com/jiji262/douyin-downloader/blob/main/config.example.yml).
### FAQ **Cookies expired?** Run `python -m tools.cookie_fetcher --config config.yml` again. **Only a few profile posts?** Keep `browser_fallback.enabled: true` and `headless: false`. Complete any verification yourself in the browser; the current verification block may still prevent downloads. **Need logs?** Run `python run.py -c config.yml -v`. ## Development ```bash python -m pip install -e ".[dev]" python -m pytest tests/ ruff check . ``` ## Community & License [QQ group](https://qm.qq.com/q/8wrCzYyLHa) · [LINUX DO](https://linux.do/) · [MIT License](https://github.com/jiji262/douyin-downloader/blob/main/LICENSE) For learning and personal data management. Respect copyright, privacy, and platform rules. You are responsible for how you use this tool; platform changes may affect availability. ## Star History [View GitHub Star History](https://www.star-history.com/?repos=jiji262%2Fdouyin-downloader&type=date&legend=top-left)
readmeHtml:
Douyin Downloader

简体中文 · English

A Douyin skill for AI agents. Let Claude Code, Codex, and other agents read the hot board, search, look up profiles, record live streams, and transcribe media. Every douyin-dl agent command prints one JSON line with stable error codes, and the bundled skill tells the agent when and how to call it. To download videos and photos without watermarks, use the Douzy desktop app.

AI Agent / Skill

1. Install the CLI

uv tool install douyin-dl-cli    # or: pipx install douyin-dl-cli
# unreleased code from GitHub: uv tool install git+https://github.com/jiji262/douyin-downloader
douyin-dl agent doctor

The PyPI package is douyin-dl-cli; the command it installs is douyin-dl. In a cloned checkout with the requirements installed, python run.py agent doctor works too. Do not pip install the package into a shared environment: its top-level packages utils, core, and config collide with other projects.

2. Install the skill (pick one)

# Claude Code
/plugin marketplace add jiji262/douyin-downloader
/plugin install douyin-dl@douyin-dl

# Codex and other agents: copy the folder (run from a clone of this repo)
cp -r skills/douyin-dl ~/.agents/skills/

# or use the skills CLI
npx skills add jiji262/douyin-downloader

3. Ask your agent

  • "What's on Douyin's hot board right now?"
  • "Search Douyin for cats and summarize the top 10 posts."
  • "Look up this creator's profile: https://www.douyin.com/user/…"
  • "Record this live room for 5 minutes: https://live.douyin.com/…"
  • "Transcribe ./clip.mp4."

The agent runs commands such as douyin-dl agent hot --max 3 and reads the single JSON line they print:

douyin-dl agent hot --max 3
# {"schema":1,"ok":true,"verb":"hot","version":"2.1.0","data":{"items":[…],"count":3},"error":null,"warnings":[]}
Status Capabilities
Available Hot search board (hot), link classification (inspect), live recording (live), local transcription (transcribe), environment check (doctor)
Sign-in required Keyword search (search), profile info (user); sign in with douyin-dl agent login in your own browser window
Blocked Downloading videos/photos, collections, music, or a profile's posts by link returns ARGUS_GATED. Use Douzy
  • Agent mode keeps its own sign-in in ~/.douyin-dl (set DOUYIN_DL_HOME to move it). It does not read config.yml or the cookies saved by tools.cookie_fetcher, and cookie values never appear in its output.
  • login needs Playwright and Chromium; transcribe needs Whisper. doctor lists what is missing with the exact install command.
  • Set DOUYIN_PROXY to send requests through a proxy.

Stable error and exit codes, field by field: contract · troubleshooting

Douzy Desktop

Download Douyin videos and photos without watermarks with a desktop app for Douyin, TikTok, YouTube, Telegram, and X. Paste links, track downloads, and browse your local archive.

Download for Windows / macOS

Platform features depend on enabled plugins or local components. Some batch and advanced features require activation.

Platform Content
Douyin Videos, photos, profiles, collections; following, subscriptions, favorites, and likes
TikTok Public videos, photos, and profiles
YouTube Videos, Shorts, channels, and playlists; audio and subtitles
Telegram Media from accessible chats, groups, and channels; requires setup and sign-in
X Posts, profile media, your bookmarks and likes; requires account cookies
Douyin TikTok YouTube
Telegram setup X Task center
Douyin (light) YouTube (light) Task center (light)

Screenshots: Douzy 0.13.0 on macOS (light and dark themes, 1440 × 900, sample data). Telegram is shown before setup. Click an image to enlarge.

Classic CLI

The original batch downloader (python run.py) supports Douyin only. It includes batch downloads, date filters, retries, download history, and optional comments, transcription, and notifications.

Download limitations: Douyin's request verification currently blocks CLI downloads of individual videos/photos, collections, music, likes, and favorites. Profile posts can try the Playwright browser fallback, but success is not guaranteed. Use Douzy for everyday downloads.

Refreshing cookies or retrying does not fix this verification block. Live recording is experimental: FFmpeg records the stream in segments, converts each segment to MP4, and reconnects after drops.

Quick Start

Requires Python 3.10+ on Windows, macOS, or Linux. Read the CLI limitations above first.

1. Install

git clone https://github.com/jiji262/douyin-downloader.git
cd douyin-downloader
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m pip install playwright
python -m playwright install chromium

2. Configure and sign in

Copy config.example.yml to config.yml:

cp config.example.yml config.yml
python -m tools.cookie_fetcher --config config.yml

On Windows PowerShell, use Copy-Item config.example.yml config.yml to copy the file. Sign in to Douyin in the browser, then return to the terminal and press Enter to save cookies.

Replace the sample link in config.yml with your creator's profile URL. Keep the saved cookies and adjust these fields:

link:
  - https://www.douyin.com/user/YOUR_SEC_UID
path: ./Downloaded/
mode: [post]
number:
  post: 10                 # 0 = unlimited
increase:
  post: true              # skip downloaded items
redownload_missing_files: true

3. Run

python run.py -c config.yml

Use python run.py --help for all options.

Option Purpose
-c, --config Config file
-u, --url Append a URL to the links in the config; repeatable
-p, --path Download folder
-t, --thread Concurrent downloads
-v, --verbose Detailed logs
Exit code Meaning
0 Finished. Some items may still have failed; check the summary
1 Nothing was downloaded or skipped and at least one item failed, or a fatal error occurred
3 The sign-in expired and could not be renewed; the other URLs in the batch were still processed

Configuration

Full settings and examples: config.example.yml.

Setting Purpose
number.post Item limit; 0 means unlimited
start_time / end_time Date range (YYYY-MM-DD); includes the whole end date
video_quality highest by default; original tries the original upload and falls back
increase.post true skips downloaded items; false downloads again and overwrites files in the selected scope
redownload_missing_files Default true: download missing files again. With false, valid database history can still skip them

Incremental downloads check for non-empty primary media on disk. You do not need to clear the database to download again: set increase.post: false. The same switch is available for like, mix, and music.

More CLI commands 
# Hot search board and keyword search → JSONL
python run.py --hot-board 30
python run.py --search "cats" --search-max 50

# Optional REST API server
python -m pip install fastapi uvicorn
python run.py --serve --serve-port 8000

Comments, transcription, notifications, and live recording are configured in config.example.yml.

FAQ

Cookies expired? Run python -m tools.cookie_fetcher --config config.yml again.

Only a few profile posts? Keep browser_fallback.enabled: true and headless: false. Complete any verification yourself in the browser; the current verification block may still prevent downloads.

Need logs? Run python run.py -c config.yml -v.

Development

python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"
python -m pytest tests/
ruff check .

Community & License

QQ group · LINUX DO · MIT License

For learning and personal data management. Respect copyright, privacy, and platform rules. You are responsible for how you use this tool; platform changes may affect availability.

Douzy Desktop 0.15.0

## 本版更新

- **全新版面**：任务中心、作品档案、五个平台首页、设置、平台与插件、关注、订阅、收藏与喜欢、多链接队列都换成新设计；勾选后底部出现操作条。
- **英文界面**：补全英文界面，侧栏左下角可以切换语言。
- **作品档案**：改成一张表，可按类型筛选、搜索标题、点表头排序；每条可以打开保存目录、打开文件、复制链接、打开原页面或删除记录；常看博主收进工具行的按钮里。
- **设置**：改成卡片式；文件命名旁加了「变量」菜单，点一下就加到模板末尾；下载与网络、TikTok、YouTube、X、Telegram 页签都画出保存后的文件夹样子。
- **多链接队列**：左边贴链接、右边看解析结果；提交、暂停 / 继续、全部取消、清空列表都在底部操作条；队列空着时说明三步用法和能识别的链接。
- **同意协议更简单**：协议页只需勾选一次；之前确认过的平台面板关掉后再打开，不再重复弹确认。

## 本版修复

- 任务行遇到不认识的链接类型时，任务中心不再整页白屏。
- 首次使用提示卡不再在「平台与插件」页出现，不会盖住那里的说明和按钮；设置页底部给提示卡留出了位置，被盖住的「已有激活码」滚一下就能点到。
- 设置 › Telegram 已登录时 API 凭据锁定，不能修改（改了也不会用到当前会话）；要换凭据请先退出登录。

## 更新说明

- 本版不强制更新：0.13.2 及以上版本可继续使用，低于 0.13.2 的版本仍需升级。
- 用户协议与隐私政策更新到 4.9.0（写明激活码使用限制、责任上限和退款规则），升级后首次启动需重新同意一次；已打开的平台面板保持打开。
- 关注页的「有新作品 / 从未提交过 / 已取消关注」改成单选；升级前同时开着几个的，只保留一个。
- 原有激活码无需重新输入。

## Downloads

- **macOS Apple Silicon:** `Douzy-arm64.dmg`
- **macOS Intel:** `Douzy-x64.dmg`
- **Windows x64:** `Douzy-Setup.exe`

## Installation

- macOS 使用现有自签名且未公证，Windows 安装包未签名，首次启动可能被系统拦截：
  - **macOS**：右键点击 Douzy.app 选「打开」，或先执行
    `xattr -cr /Applications/Douzy.app`。
  - **macOS 钥匙串**：升级后 macOS 可能询问是否允许 Douzy 访问「Douzy Safe Storage」，请选「始终允许」。
    误点拒绝请退出重开 Douzy 后再选允许。
  - **Windows**：SmartScre

releases.body:
Douzy Desktop 0.14.0

## 本版更新


- **批量结果导出**：批量下载可导出完整下载结果（CSV、JSON）和失败链接（TXT）。

## 更新说明

- 本版不强制更新：0.13.2 及以上版本可继续使用，低于 0.13.2 的版本仍需升级。
- 用户协议与隐私政策更新到 4.8.0（说明 App 内购买与续费），升级后首次启动需重新同意一次。
- 原有激活码无需重新输入。

## Downloads

- **macOS Apple Silicon:** `Douzy-arm64.dmg`
- **macOS Intel:** `Douzy-x64.dmg`
- **Windows x64:** `Douzy-Setup.exe`

## Installation

- macOS 使用现有自签名且未公证，Windows 安装包未签名，首次启动可能被系统拦截：
  - **macOS**：右键点击 Douzy.app 选「打开」，或先执行
    `xattr -cr /Applications/Douzy.app`。
  - **macOS 钥匙串**：升级后 macOS 可能询问是否允许 Douzy 访问「Douzy Safe Storage」，请选「始终允许」。
    误点拒绝请退出重开 Douzy 后再选允许。
  - **Windows**：SmartScreen 提示时选「更多信息 → 仍要运行」。
- Windows 新版为 per-machine 安装；旧版用户建议先卸载旧副本再安装。
- Telegram 需要用户自己的 `api_id` / `api_hash`，不填不影响其他平台。
- 标准版单链接任务入口无需邀请码；批量队列和高级 UI 流程仍需内测资格。

releases.name: Desktop 0.13.2
releases.body:
Douzy Desktop 0.13.2

## 本版修复

- 修复 0.13.0 / 0.13.1 在历史作品库较大时，后台服务启动卡住、反复超时的问题，避免启动前扫描整个作品库或创建昂贵索引。
- 订阅作品保存后立即记录到「最近保存」，避免并发下载、取消或中断后漏记；清理任务记录后仍保留摘要。
- 修复删除任务时可能误删作品摘要的问题，并完善写入失败回滚与启动诊断日志。

## 更新说明

- 本版设为强制更新：最低支持版本为 0.13.2，低于 0.13.2 的版本需升级后继续使用；0.13.2 及以上版本正常使用。
- 升级时较早的订阅摘要可能不会回填；后续订阅保存会即时显示。

## Downloads

- **macOS Apple Silicon:** `Douzy-arm64.dmg`
- **macOS Intel:** `Douzy-x64.dmg`
- **Windows x64:** `Douzy-Setup.exe`

## Installation

- macOS 使用现有自签名且未公证，Windows 安装包未签名，首次启动可能被系统拦截：
  - **macOS**：右键点击 Douzy.app 选「打开」，或先执行
    `xattr -cr /Applications/Douzy.app`。
  - **macOS 钥匙串**：从 0.12.4 及更早版本升级后，macOS 会询问是否允许 Douzy 访问「Douzy Safe Storage」，

- Windows 新版为 per-machine 安装；旧版用户建议先卸载旧副本再安装。
- Telegram 需要用户自己的 `api_id` / `api_hash`，不填不影响其他平台。
- 标准版单链接任务入口无需邀请码；批量队列和高级 UI 流程仍需内测资格。

releases.body:
Douzy Desktop 0.12.11

## 本版修复

- 修复 YouTube 字幕限流或下载失败导致主视频中断的问题，保留真实媒体失败的正确提示。
- 修复评论限流时被保存为空文件的问题，并支持补抓未完整获取的评论。

## Downloads

- **macOS Apple Silicon:** `Douzy-arm64.dmg`
- **macOS Intel:** `Douzy-x64.dmg`
- **Windows x64:** `Douzy-Setup.exe`

## Installation

- macOS 使用自签名且未公证，Windows 安装包未签名，首次启动可能被系统拦截：
  - **macOS**：右键点击 Douzy.app 选「打开」，或先执行
    `xattr -cr /Applications/Douzy.app`。
  - **macOS 钥匙串**：从 0.12.4 及更早版本升级后，macOS 会询问是否允许 Douzy 访问「Douzy Safe Storage」，
    请选「始终允许」；之后再升级不会再询问。误点拒绝请退出重开 Douzy 后再选允许。
  - **Windows**：SmartScreen 提示时选「更多信息 → 仍要运行」。
- Windows 新版为 per-machine 安装；旧版用户建议先卸载旧副本再安装。
- Telegram 需要用户自己的 `api_id` / `api_hash`，不填不影响其他平台。
- 标准版单链接任务入口无需邀请码；批量队列和高级 UI 流程仍需内测资格。

aiSummary.oneLiner: An automated batch downloading tool for extracting unwatermarked media from Douyin profiles and collections.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Douyin Downloader provides an automated, reliable pipeline for extracting varied media types from Douyin. It supports large-scale batch downloading of individual videos, image notes, audio tracks, and entire creator profiles. Crucially, the tool actively circumvents common download hurdles by stripping visual watermarks and utilizing an automated browser fallback mechanism when standard APIs fail. To ensure data integrity during massive archival runs, it employs an embedded SQLite database for strict file deduplication and automatic retry logic.
keyFeatures: Batch processing: Downloads entire user profiles, collections, and favorite lists in a single automated run.
Watermark removal: Strips unwanted visual watermarks from downloaded video content for clean playback.
Data deduplication: Prevents redundant file downloads by tracking history using an embedded SQLite database.
Integrity checks: Validates files post-download to guarantee completeness and prevent corrupted archives.
Browser fallback mechanism: Employs automated browser techniques to extract media when direct API access is blocked.
